title: Interior Paint Systems — Paints, Coatings, Sealants and Adhesives
body:
Interior Paint Systems. This record belongs to the Paints, Coatings, Sealants and Adhesives database and covers interior paint systems in full working detail: what it is, when it applies, how it is set out, and how it is checked. The database as a whole covers paints, coatings, sealants and adhesives: selection, application and performance.

Actual content. Interior Paint Systems is executed as follows. First, confirm the building type, the project stage and the governing requirements for the jurisdiction, and record those decisions before any dimension or quantity is fixed. Second, lay out the work from the controlling dimensions, keeping clearances, tolerances and interfaces with adjoining work explicit rather than assumed. Third, work through the sequence in order, checking each interface — structure to envelope, services to structure, finish to substrate — before closing up work that will hide it.
